tools.name: cancel_action
tools.title: Cancel a prepared action
tools.description: Discards a prepared action the user did not approve.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.title: Confirm a prepared action
tools.description:
Step 2 of 2: executes an action returned by prepare_refund or prepare_stock_adjustment.
Only call this after the user explicitly approved the summary. Tokens expire after a few minutes,
work once, and only for the API key that prepared them.

tools.name: list_pending_actions
tools.title: List pending actions
tools.description: Actions this API key prepared that are still waiting for confirmation.

tools.name: prepare_refund
tools.title: Prepare a refund
tools.description:
Step 1 of 2 for refunding an order. Checks the amount against what is still refundable and the
per-refund limit, then returns a confirmation token and a summary. Does NOT move money.
Show the summary to the user; only after they clearly approve, call confirm_action with the token.

tools.name: prepare_stock_adjustment
tools.title: Prepare a stock adjustment
tools.description:
Step 1 of 2 for correcting stock (positive delta = add units, negative = remove). Checks the SKU,
the per-adjustment limit and that stock cannot go below zero, then returns a confirmation token.
Does NOT change stock until confirm_action is called after the user approves.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.title: Check inventory
tools.description:
Stock levels by SKU with reorder level, a lowStock flag and units sold in the last 30 days.
Low-stock items are listed first. Filter by SKU/name text, category, or lowStockOnly.

tools.name: find_customers
tools.title: Find customers
tools.description: Find customers by part of their name or email. Returns order count, lifetime value (USD, net of refunds) and last order time.

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order with customer, line items, refunds so far and the amount that can still be refunded (USD).

tools.name: sales_summary
tools.title: Sales summary
tools.description: Orders, revenue, refunds, average order value, orders by status and the top 5 products for the last N days (USD).

tools.name: search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description:
Search shop orders, newest first. All filters are optional and combine with AND.
Returns id, status, customer, line count, total and refunded amount (USD) and creation time (UTC).
Use get_order for line items and refund history.
